Title: General availability: Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server in new China regions

Body.Content:
With the addition of Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server to the China North 3 and China East 3 regions, you can now enjoy a simplified provisioning experience with: 

  • Optimized lower total cost of ownership (TCO)
  • Better resiliency with zone redundant high availability in selected regions 
  • Enterprise security with virtual network isolation and data encryption
  • Access to the stop/start feature
  • More control with custom one hour maintenance 
  • The openness of the Postgres database community version   

Read the documentation to learn more about Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server and visit the Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Flexible Server availability by region section to learn more about regional availability.
